subject: general
question: Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution. 'I __prefer travelling on train than travelling by bus__ as I suffer from motion sickness.

options.text: Prefer travelling in train to travelling by bus
Prefer travelling by train to travelling by bus
Prefer travelling by train than travelling by bus

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Prefer travelling by train to travelling by bus .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence uses comparative preference, which requires the structure **"prefer + verb-ing + by + mode of transport to + verb-ing + by + mode of transport."**
 
• The word **"than"** in the original sentence is incorrect because **"to"** is the correct preposition for expressing preference.
 
• The correct phrase is **"prefer travelling by train to travelling by bus"**, as it aligns with standard English grammar rules for expressing preference.

Correct sentence: *I prefer travelling by train to travelling by bus as I suffer from motion sickness*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of prepositions in comparisons:**

 
 
• **"Prefer...to"** is the correct structure to compare two activities or objects.
 
• For example: **She prefers tea to coffee.**
 
 
 
• **Incorrect structures:**

 
 
• **"Prefer...than"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• For example: **"Prefer tea than coffee"** is wrong.
